inlines.value: category control the arrangement and style of literal, listing, and source blocks as well as literal table cells.
key is used to tune the height of the background color applied to a span of block text highlighted using Rouge.
category only applies when you use Rouge as the source highlighter. Otherwise, the background color is controlled by the source highlighter theme.
category only applies when you use Pygments as the source highlighter. Otherwise, the font color of line numbers is controlled by the source highlighter theme.
